**As a** <student / parent / teacher / admin>, **I want** <goal>, **so that** <reason>.

**Requirements:** FR-/NFR- IDs

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given … when … then …

### Definition of ready
- [ ] Acceptance criteria written
- [ ] Linked to SRS IDs and the MVP increment (F1 / F2)
- [ ] Telemetry events listed (if it touches the game)
- [ ] Estimate ≤ 3 days (otherwise split)
